items.title: Deere (DE) Will Close Two Iowa Plants And Shift Some Production To Brazil
items.summary: Deere (NYSE:DE) plans to close two manufacturing plants in Iowa as part of a broader rework of its production footprint. The machinery producer intends to shift some of the affected output to other US facilities and move additional work to Brazil. Management has framed the multi year restructuring as an effort to better align manufacturing capacity with current demand patterns.
